strongest_authored_result: For n >= 2, canonical Alexander simplex interpolation has worst-case arity amplification between m/pi and 2m+1; a specified interpolation rule fails dimension-uniform local control.
strongest_result_scope_limit: This is a failure of one interpolation construction, including in the already-solved spatial dimension two. It is not a non-ANR theorem.
exact_main_gap: No neighborhood extension over arbitrary metrizable parameter spaces is proved for Homeo(D^n rel boundary) in n > 2, and no compact-manifold counterexample is produced.
noncompact_scope: The escaping-twist counterexample is attributed to Edwards–Kirby (1971), printed p. 77, and is not counted as a solution of the intended compact-manifold question.
approach_names: Ambient inverse-pair retraction and convex interpolation
Finite-dimensional compact exhaustion and ANR recognition
